FAQ

Questions, answered.

What does PayGlocal charge? Is there a setup fee?
PayGlocal charges a competitive MDR on international transactions with no setup fee and no hidden FX markup. Volume-based pricing is available. Contact us for a custom quote based on your transaction mix and volume.
Is PayGlocal RBI-authorised?
Yes. PayGlocal is an RBI-licensed Payment Aggregator – Cross Border (PA-CB), which means we are authorised to process international payments and remittances for Indian businesses under RBI's Master Directions on Payment Aggregators.
How long does settlement take, and how do I get my FIRA?
INR settlement typically happens within T+2 working days. FIRA (Foreign Inward Remittance Advice) is generated automatically on every cross-border settlement and delivered directly to your inbox - no bank visit or manual follow-up required.
How quickly can I go live?
Most businesses are live within 3 business days of completing onboarding. Our integration supports Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, and direct API with SDKs for all major languages. A dedicated onboarding team is available throughout.
What happens if a transaction fails or I get a chargeback?
PayGlocal's ML-based fraud engine blocks high-risk transactions before they complete, which significantly reduces chargebacks. For eligible chargebacks that do occur, PayGlocal provides 100% chargeback cover - protecting your revenue without manual disputes.
